quotaRules.definition: Each negative subtype has at least 25 cases.
Each supported questionLanguage, pt-BR and en-GB, has at least 25 negative cases.
Each active database by questionLanguage has at least 2 positive cases and 1 negative case.
Each active document by questionLanguage has at least 1 positive case.
Each questionLanguage crossed with each exact contentLanguage has at least 25 positive cases.
Each active document format has at least 25 positive cases.
Each source stratum has at least 25 positive cases.

primaryCountingRule: A case may satisfy different quota families but counts once by its primary assignment within each family; additional qrel associations do not duplicate the count.
comparativePilotBoundary: Meeting the frozen base quotas permits only COMPARATIVE_PILOT.
representativeClaimBoundary: Representative product homologation additionally requires at least 30 positive cases per active database and per source stratum, with both questionLanguages represented.
underpoweredRule: Every mandatory stratum below 30 is UNDERPOWERED and blocks a representative claim even if aggregate metrics pass; there is no catalogue ceiling.
